title: 응급실 접수: 어디가, 왜 아파요?
objective: Tell an ER nurse your symptoms and give the reason with -기 때문에.
summary: Tell the ER nurse your symptoms and why, using -기 때문에.
setting: A hospital ER front desk late at night. A foreign patient with a bad stomachache checks in.

task.title: Explain your symptoms
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to fill in, choose, order, or answer in Korean.

words.example: 밤에는 병원이 문을 닫아서 응급실에 갔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The hospital was closed at night, so I went to the ER.

words.meaning: to check in (at a hospital desk)
words.exampleMeaning: Please check in over there first.

words.meaning: the person who comes with a patient (family or friend)
words.exampleMeaning: Please write down the phone number of the person with you.
I threw up right after eating.
I feel dizzy when I stand up.
I've been coughing for a whole week.

words.meaning: (of a doctor) to see and treat a patient
words.exampleMeaning: The doctor will see you soon.

dialogue.meaning: What's wrong? Where does it hurt?

dialogue.korean: 배가 너무 아파요. 어젯밤부터 계속 아팠어요.
dialogue.meaning: My stomach really hurts. It has hurt since last night without stopping.

dialogue.korean: 아니요, 계속 토했기 때문에 약을 못 먹었어요.
dialogue.meaning: No, I couldn't take any because I kept throwing up.

dialogue.korean: 지금 환자가 많기 때문에 조금 기다리셔야 돼요. 많이 아픈 분부터 진료해요.
dialogue.meaning: There are a lot of patients now, so you'll have to wait a little. The doctor sees the sickest people first.

exercises: Fill in the blank with the -기 때문에 form of the word in brackets: 머리가 너무 (어지럽다) ____ 혼자 못 왔어요.
Choose the right word (보호자 / 접수 / 진료) for each blank: ① 병원에 도착하면 먼저 ____를 하세요. ② ____분은 밖에서 기다려 주세요. ③ 의사 선생님이 지금 다른 환자를 ____하고 있어요.
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 응급실에 / 피가 / 왔어요 / 손에서 / 나기 때문에 / 계속
Answer in Korean with -기 때문에, using the dialogue: ① 환자는 왜 약을 못 먹었어요? ② 환자는 왜 기다려야 돼요?
answers: ① 접수 ② 보호자 ③ 진료
손에서 피가 계속 나기 때문에 응급실에 왔어요. (손에서 계속 피가 나기 때문에 응급실에 왔어요. / 계속 손에서 피가 나기 때문에 응급실에 왔어요.)
① 계속 토했기 때문에 약을 못 먹었어요. ② 지금 환자가 많기 때문에 기다려야 돼요.
